name: Transport Phenomena in Complex Fluids
description: Introduction to soft matter and complex fluids. Structure-property relation and microstructural origin of deformation. Linear and non-linear viscoelasticity. Transport processes and structure-property relations in various complex fluids such as polymers, colloids and emulsions; suspensions, surfactant micelles, nano-emulsions, gels, liquid crystalline polymers, foam, etc. Polymer statics and dynamics. Origin of elasticity in polymeric fluids; rheometry and constitutive modeling of complex fluids focusing on polymers. Linear and non-linear viscoelastic models and solutions; rheology of suspensions. Transport processes in complex fluids.
